title: 3887. Incremental Even-Weighted Cycle Queries

examples.explanation: [0, 1, 1]: We add the edge between vertex 0 and vertex 1 with weight 1. [1, 2, 1]: We add the edge between vertex 1 and vertex 2 with weight 1. [0, 2, 1]: The edge between vertex 0 and vertex 2 (the dashed edge in the diagram) is not added because the cycle 0 - 1 - 2 - 0 has total edge weight 1 + 1 + 1 = 3, which is an odd number.

[0, 1, 1]: We add the edge between vertex 0 and vertex 1 with weight 1. [1, 2, 1]: We add the edge between vertex 1 and vertex 2 with weight 1. [0, 2, 0]: We add the edge between vertex 0 and vertex 2 with weight 0. Note that the cycle 0 - 1 - 2 - 0 has total edge weight 1 + 1 + 0 = 2, which is an even number.
